pkgmetadata.longdescription: Top-level meta-package used to deploy and manage the complete WakStab system baseline, pulling in Portage configuration trees, kernel configuration fragments, and helper utilities via USE flags.

use.flag: Manage bootloader and Secure Boot mode via sys-boot/wakstab-bootcfg
Install app-misc/wakstab-menu Kconfig USE flag manager TUI
Install system configuration files via sys-config/wakstab-configs
Install kernel configuration files via sys-kernel/wakstab-kernel-config
Install Portage helper scripts via app-portage/wakstab-scripts
